Subject: MAP: BrightLoop evaluation plan & ownership alignment

Hi Avery / BrightLoop team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — excited to kick off the formal evaluation. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_BrightLoop_v1.1.xlsx) that lays out the POC scope, success criteria, owners, and a suggested timeline. High level notes: 

- Objective: validate Redwood inference for BrightLoop search-ranking pipeline with 95th pct latency < 250ms and per-query cost <= $0.015 at benchmark QPS.
- Success criteria (proposed): latency target above, embedding cosine recall >= 0.92 on sample bench, and stable throughput at 50 QPS sustained for 30m.
- Deliverables: evaluation harness (benchmark scripts + prompts), model/quantization recommendations, and integration sanity checks.

Requested next steps:
1) Confirm internal BrightLoop stakeholders who will be active for prompts, data access, and approvals.
2) Confirm the timeline below or suggest adjustments.

Proposed timeline (start this week):
- Week 0 (this week): stakeholder/infra access + finalize MAP
- Week 1: benchmark harness + sample prompts loaded
- Week 2: run benchmarks, iterate on prompt sets and quantization profiles
- Week 3: results review and decision meeting (go/no-go)

I've linked a working Drive copy here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cBrightLoopMAP and attached the MAP.

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood: Jonas Weber (overall), Marissa Cole (eval infra & benchmark harness), Stephanie Nguyen (security/compliance checkpoints)
- BrightLoop: please confirm a technical lead (prompts/metrics) and a PM for decisioning

Can you confirm stakeholders and whether the timeline looks OK? Happy to schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff call today or tomorrow.

Thanks,
